title: L.A.’s Iconic Central Library Turns 100!
description:
Los Angeles Central Library celebrates 100 years of learning, connection, and service to Angelenos. The centennial celebration brings the community together for live performances, arts and crafts, family activities, and resources from local nonprofits and public institutions.

Since opening in 1926, Central Library has evolved with the changing needs of Los Angeles, expanding access to books, technology, the internet, AI education, and other valuable services. Its enduring mission remains the same: to serve communities across the city and inspire generations through the light of learning.

To learn more about services, events, or to plan your visit to the LA Public Library, go to https://www.lapl.org/
